decision: Unit = charging session; positive = abnormal ending (13 fault causes); prediction at Start Time; use = ranked risk alerts for preventive monitoring and maintenance prioritisation.
evidence: Brief, Section 2; target mapping validated against the dataset's own history columns in Task 1 (§5.2), instructor confirmation pending.

decision: 27 original columns are eligible (29 features in 7 groups). Excluded: 1 target-only column, 7 generated during or after the session, 12 for other reasons (identifier, uncertain timing, redundancy).
evidence: Every one of the 47 columns appears once in the classification table; reasons and evidence per column in Section 4.

decision: A missed failure costs more per event than a false alert, but false alerts are capped by inspection capacity: evaluate the ranking and the result at a fixed alert budget. The cut-off is chosen later from the cost ratio and the capacity.
evidence: Failures cluster by post (Task 1 §9.4); best cut-off t* = 1/(1 + c) falls below the abnormal share for c > 4.4.

decision: Primary: PR-AUC. Complementary: ROC-AUC, Brier score, log-loss. Operational: precision, recall and correct / false / missed alerts per 1,000 sessions at alert budgets of 5%, 10% and 20%. Stability: per-fold values, std, worst fold, trend, wins against the baseline. Accuracy, F1, kappa and MCC are not used for model comparison.
evidence: Abnormal share ~18.5% with unequal error costs; the share moves between periods, so lift and fixed budgets are needed (Sections 5 and 7).

decision: Burn-in before 2020-04-01; development 2020-04-01 to 2021-09-30 with four expanding-window folds (validation = consecutive quarters 2020-Q4 to 2021-Q3); test from 2021-10-01 untouched. No random splitting.
evidence: Prevalence, volume and fault mix change over time (Task 1 §7); fold sizes 41.8k–75.8k validation, 111k–271k training; every fold has ≥ 6,600 abnormal sessions.

decision: Training sessions that end after the validation start are removed from that fold's training set.
evidence: A label exists only when the session ends (up to 24 h later); 27–39 sessions per fold.

decision: Rank models by the unweighted mean of per-fold PR-AUC; also report the session-weighted mean and the pooled value; stability = std, worst fold and trend; compare models fold by fold (paired differences, folds won). No p-values from four folds.
evidence: Periods are the unit of generalisation; abnormal share differs by fold (15.8%–21.1%); the smallest exact Wilcoxon p with 4 folds is 0.125.

decision: B0 no skill (random scores, constant training prior, 'always normal') and B1 simple rule: score = post_previous_abnormal_rate_7D (no fitting).
evidence: B0 gives PR-AUC = abnormal share and ROC-AUC = 0.5, so the share changes the target a model must beat; B1 is the strongest single start-time signal in Task 1 (§9.4).
